title: Launch film squeezed into a 0.5 MB size budget
caption: The Magnifito launch film re-encoded by mgvideo optimize to fit a 0.5 MB budget (two-pass, bitrate worked out from the duration). The split shows the original on the left and the budgeted file on the right, with both real file sizes. Behind the clip: mgvideo validate on a fresh render of the 01 project and the YouTube chapters from its scene plan.
prompt: The client needs the launch film ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 as a tiny file for an email preview: at most 0.5 MB. Run it through the size optimizer and show the client what that costs: a split with the original on the left and the budgeted file on the right, a thin cream divider and labels with the real file sizes in Geist from fonts/. Also prepare the delivery checks for the same project (../01-branded-promo): render it in a scratch copy, run mgvideo validate on the newest run and generate the YouTube chapters from its scene plan, and keep both reports with the clip.
commands: ffmpeg -i ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 -i work/budget.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v]crop=960:1080:0:0[l];[1:v]crop=960:1080:960:0[r];[l][r]hstack=inputs=2,drawbox=x=958:y=0:w=4:h=1080:color=0xf0eadf:t=fill[c];[c][2:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -crf 14 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/compare.mp4
